environment: **Primary use of Claude Code**: development of Soporte, a multi-tenant ticketing SaaS

**Trusted repo**: C:\trabajos\soporte and its origin remote https://github.com/npelizzari1217/soporte.git — private repository. Private means confidential material may be committed here, but secrets and credentials are never cleared by visibility.
**Default / protected branches**: main is the default branch; gh lists no branch protection rules or rulesets, so the branch-and-PR policy is enforced by convention, not by the forge
**Source control**: npelizzari1217/soporte and its origin remote only — no additional orgs configured
**Key internal services**: soporte-postgres-master, the local Docker Postgres container for this project (port 5432), holding the soporte_master control database

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: backend/.env and frontend/.env.local hold local secrets — never commit, push, or paste them. backend/.env.example and frontend/.env.example are safe templates. Every tenant database registered in the clientes table of soporte_master is real customer data.
**Secrets management**: local .env files only — no secrets manager is configured for this project
soft_deny: Bash(dropdb:*), DROP DATABASE, DROP TABLE, and TRUNCATE against soporte_master or against any tenant database registered in its clientes table — these hold real customer data and must never be destroyed. Only throwaway local test databases are fair game.
